summary: Story decomposition is sound and resolves the prior split verdict. The former oversized leaf is now two direct children: story WI-03c1 (simulation half, nested into accepted leaves WI-03c1a and WI-03c1b - a permitted story-in-story refinement documented in WI-03c1's own plan) and leaf WI-03c2 (production presence). The leaf union covers the whole parent scope with nothing dropped: WI-03c1a lands the 4-6 tier-3 CreatureDefs plus the section 10 damage model per size class (2 subsystems, 1 behavior); WI-03c1b lands the per-predator controllers incl. the non-chase hunting strategy, one headless trigger-plus-control signature scenario per predator, and the FINAL PROOF AC-roster-behavior roster check (2 subsystems, 3 named responsibilities, scenarios and roster check being the leaf's tests/evidence); WI-03c2 lands tier-3 spawns on the section 39 bands with section 34 caps, data-driven predator body shapes plus pre-contact telegraph/commit on the existing WI-02b pipeline, and the tier's one browser spot-check (2 subsystems, 1 behavior). Every leaf carries a strict subset of the parent's changed subsystems and, at both levels, a strict subset of its parent's criteria (WI-03c1b qualifies on the subsystems disjunct; its scenarios are tests, not extra behaviors). Dependencies are correct and in order: WI-03c depends on WI-03b (accepted; the final behavior/friendly proof counts WI-03b1's friendly species); WI-03c1b depends on WI-03c1a; WI-03c2 depends on sibling story WI-03c1, which correctly means both of its leaves; no ancestor/descendant or circular edges; WI-03b/ST-01/ST-02 are inherited through the story chain. Acceptance is preserved: child criteria are verbatim parent text and the union at each level covers all three parent criteria (AC-roster-count via WI-03c2, AC-roster-behavior via WI-03c1's leaves, AC-roster-tests via both). Final proof ownership is named and consistent with ST-03: AC-roster-behavior final owner WI-03c1b (running after WI-03b lands); the roster-wide 15+ count and the roster-wide test-existence/spoiler audit finalize in WI-03d, which already depends on WI-03c (all leaves). Each leaf stands alone with concrete file pointers (hiddenCreatures.ts, worldData.ts, scenario.ts), request sections, WI-01b organism ids, design_private/ as source of truth, the section 11.2/46 hard gates, the falsifiable ST-02 assumption, and spoiler-safe commit style - fresh-session ready. Minor, non-blocking: WI-03c's 'Why this shape' body still calls WI-03c1 a leaf; its ownership description is accurate and the nested split is documented and accepted downstream, so no boundary is contradicted.
